tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public products, technical documents, material selection and contact information. Returns citable document IDs for fetch. Use product terms or a concise user question; no web-wide search.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a complete public source returned by search. IDs are language/slug, for example tr/hus-kontrplak. Includes canonical citation URL and content date. Cannot retrieve external URLs, files or private data.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List public product families and plywood series, their exact IDs and source URLs. A listing is not a statement of stock availability.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read product description, published technical tables, applicable source documents and caveats. Use exact product ID from list_products. Never generalize one variant to an entire family.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Return 2–3 products side by side with source-scoped facts and full technical context. Missing facts remain missing; different tests or units are not treated as equivalent.

tools.name: find_material
tools.description: Find candidate products using Kariwood published application guidance. Omit application to list supported application IDs, then select one. Candidates require project-specific confirmation; not an engineering calculation.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get public sales contacts and quotation preparation guidance. Use for prices, availability, delivery, unsupported products or missing information. Does not send messages, create leads or place orders.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, list_products, get_contact · Private data: search, fetch, get_product, get_contact · Public sink: get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, list_products, get_contact · Private data: search, fetch, get_product, get_contact · Public sink: get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
